description: 2D primitive — a Length × Breadth rectangle centred at (X, Y) in metres. Emits a Space polygon.
instructions:
A 2D primitive source — emits a Length × Breadth rectangle Space centred at (centerX, centerY) in metres, optionally rotated. It has no geometry input; feed its output into the Space pipeline exactly like a Space source. Also publishes `val-length` / `val-breadth` for wiring downstream.

TIP: use it as a quick test Space, or a parametric footprint whose size is driven by wiring numbers into `valin-length` / `valin-breadth` (e.g. from a Math node).
